## Walkthrough A new Kubernetes `ApplianceConfig` manifest was added for version 4.23, specifying appliance configuration including disk size settings, registry behavior flags, image registry configuration, and a curated list of operator packages from Red Hat's operator index. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**New ApplianceConfig Manifest**
`tools/iso_builder/config/4.23/appliance-config.yaml`|Added new Kubernetes ApplianceConfig manifest (v1beta1) defining appliance settings: 200GB disk size, registry flags (`stopLocalRegistry`, `enableDefaultSources`, `skipLocalRegistry`, `enableInteractiveFlow`), binary-based image registry, support tools image reference, and 14 operator packages from `registry.redhat.io/redhat/redhat-operator-index:v4.21`.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~5 minutes

tools/iso_builder/config/4.23/appliance-config.yaml (1)
`11-12`: **Consider pinning the support-tools image to a specific version.** Using the `:latest` tag can lead to non-reproducible builds and unexpected updates. For production appliance configurations, consider pinning to a specific version or digest.
📌 Example with pinned version ```diff additionalImages: - - name: registry.redhat.io/rhel9/support-tools:latest + - name: registry.redhat.io/rhel9/support-tools:9.5-1234567890 ``` Replace `9.5-1234567890` with the actual desired version.
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed. In `@tools/iso_builder/config/4.23/appliance-config.yaml` around lines 11 - 12, The additionalImages entry currently pins the support-tools image using the ambiguous tag name "registry.redhat.io/rhel9/support-tools:latest", which can make builds unreproducible; update the additionalImages list so the image name field uses a specific version tag or an immutable digest instead of :latest (e.g., replace "registry.redhat.io/rhel9/support-tools:latest" with a specific tag like "registry.redhat.io/rhel9/support-tools:9.x.y" or the image digest), ensuring the change is applied to the additionalImages → name entry to guarantee deterministic appliance builds. ```
